Hi everyone!
I’d like to hear from you in case someone encountered the same issue … 

I lost my French driving license a while ago in Israel (just the card, I’m still allowed to drive), before converting it. 

Because I’m not a French resident, I can’t renew it. I got a document from the French ministry of transport to attest that I do have a driving licence, but the Israeli ministry of transport won’t accept it to issue the Israeli driving licence (they want the card). 

So I guess that I’m gonna have to pass the driving test in Israel to get a licence …

Does someone know whether there is a shortcut to pass the test? Or do I obviously have to go through the 28 hours of practice driving with an instructor? 

Thanks a lot for your help ! 🌸
